tasks.title: Volunteer matching service priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: In your English class you have been discussing how a volunteer matching service should decide which local projects to support. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
paragraphs: 1. matching volunteers to projects near their homes
2. providing training for volunteers before they start

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Volunteer matching service review
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you used a volunteer matching service to find a project? We want to hear about your experience.
Write a review of the service for a specialist magazine about volunteering.
Describe how the service matched you with a project, say how well it prepared you for the role, and recommend one improvement the service could make.
The best reviews will be published in next month's issue.

tasks.title: Volunteer matching service article
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our volunteer matching service wants to improve how we support volunteers after they start a project.
Write an article for the programme coordinator's website suggesting one practical way the service could help volunteers stay motivated and committed long-term.
Explain why your idea would work and what the benefits would be for both volunteers and the projects they join.
We will publish the best articles on our website.

tasks.title: Volunteer matching service email
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Volunteer matching service in your area
paragraphs: I heard that your town has a volunteer matching service that connects people with local projects. I'm thinking of suggesting something similar in my city.
Could you tell me what you think makes the service effective? What's the biggest challenge it faces? And how does it make sure volunteers are reliable?

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Sam. You should explain what makes the service effective, describe one challenge, and suggest how the service encourages reliability.

tasks.purpose: explain a position and request arrangements
tasks.originalityCheck: Email is from a friend asking about a service, not about a festival, course, or weekend job. Content points are specific to volunteer matching.

designReview.overallOriginalityStatement: All tasks are based on the volunteer matching service scenario, which is new and not used in any previous test. The specific setting, audiences, purposes, and content points are unique and match the design fingerprint. No forbidden concepts are used. The essay notes, review announcement, article announcement, and email are all original and do not reuse skeletons from previous tests.
